seo.description: How TripAgent membership works: invitation and complimentary period, billing, cancellation and what the fee covers.

hero.heading: Terms & Conditions
hero.standfirst: How membership works, in plain words: kept as it should be: clear, and without surprises.

nodes.html: Welcome. These terms explain how TripAgent membership works. By accepting an invitation and becoming a member, you agree to them.
Your membership
TripAgent membership gives you a named travel advisor and an AI concierge who plan, book and look after your flights, hotels and visas. Membership is personal to you and offered at our discretion.
The complimentary period, and what happens after

items: Membership is by invitation. Each invitation carries a one-time code that grants a complimentary period, set per invitation, with the full service and no membership fee.
A card is saved securely when you redeem your invitation, with a zero-amount check: nothing is charged.
There is no membership fee today. If we ever introduce one, we will tell you the amount well in advance, and you will be charged only if you choose to continue.

nodes.html: Cancelling
Cancel at any time: message your advisor or write to invite@tripagent.vip. Nothing is charged for leaving.
What you pay for

Membership itself is free during your complimentary period: the advisor relationship and the concierge. Travel itself, air fares, hotel rooms and visa government fees, is paid per trip, transparently, with taxes shown. We never add hidden markups; our service fee is shown before you confirm.
Bookings & suppliers

Flights, hotels and visas are provided by airlines, hotels, bedbanks and government authorities. Their own terms, fare rules and timelines apply to each booking. Your advisor makes these clear before you commit.
Prices and payment

items: Every price is shown in Indian rupees before you pay. It includes the airline or hotel fare, TripAgent's service fee and the GST (and, where the law requires it, TCS) on your booking, each shown on its own line.

Fares and room rates are live and can change until a booking is paid for. We check the price again just before you pay; if it has moved, we show you the new price first and you choose whether to go ahead.
You pay in one secure payment through our regulated payment partner (cards, UPI, net banking and wallets). We never see or store your full card number.
A booking is confirmed only once your payment has been received and the airline or hotel has confirmed it. We send the e-ticket or hotel confirmation to your email.

nodes.html: Your details

Names must match the passport or government ID each traveller will carry. Airlines and hotels may refuse travel or charge for corrections if they don't, and we are not responsible for refusals caused by incorrect details you gave us.
Cancellations, changes and refunds
How cancellations, date changes and refunds work, and how long refunds take, is set out in our Cancellation & Refund Policy, which forms part of these terms.
Who you are dealing with
TripAgent is a brand of Polaris Commerce Group Private Limited, a private limited company registered in India. Its registered details are set out at the end of this page.
Using the service well
Please give accurate traveller details and use the service for lawful, personal travel. We may decline or end a membership that is misused.
Our responsibility

We take great care, but are not liable for events outside our control (airline cancellations, weather, government decisions). Where we are responsible, our liability is limited to the amount you paid us for the booking concerned. Nothing here limits rights you have under Indian law.
Governing law
These terms are governed by the laws of India; disputes are subject to the courts of Bangalore, India.

seo.title: Privacy Policy | TripAgent
seo.description: What we collect, why, and the control you keep: under India's DPDP Act.

hero.heading: Privacy Policy
hero.standfirst: Your trust is the thing we look after most. Here is what we hold, why, and the control you keep.

nodes.html: This explains what we collect, why we collect it, and the control you keep over it: under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act.
What we collect

items: You give us: name, email, mobile, city, how you travel, and trip details you share with your advisor.
To take payment: card or UPI details are entered directly with our regulated payment partner. We do not see or store your card number.
Automatically: basic, privacy-respecting usage data to keep the site working.

nodes.html: Why we use it
To plan and book your travel, introduce your advisor, take payment for your bookings, send you trip and service messages, and meet legal and tax obligations in India.
Our lawful basis (India DPDP)
We process your data with your consent and to provide the service you asked for, in line with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. You may withdraw consent at any time.
Who we share it with

Only as needed to serve you: your advisor; the airlines, hotels and visa authorities required to complete a booking; our payment processor; and our technology providers under confidentiality. We do not sell your data.
How long we keep it
For as long as you are a member and as long as the law requires (tax and booking records), then we delete or anonymise it.
Your rights
Ask us to show, correct or delete your data, or to withdraw consent: write to invite@tripagent.vip and we act promptly.
Security
We hold your data on bank-grade infrastructure with access controls and encryption in transit. Payments run on PCI-compliant rails.
Grievances and contact
For any question or complaint about how we handle your personal data, contact our grievance officer:

items: Email invite@tripagent.vip
Response acknowledged within 48 hours, resolved within 30 days, as the law requires.

nodes.html: The data fiduciary is Polaris Commerce Group Private Limited; its registered details are below.

seo.title: Cancellation & Refund Policy | TripAgent
seo.description: How to cancel or change a TripAgent booking, what is refunded, and how long refunds take.

hero.heading: Cancellation & Refund Policy
hero.standfirst: How to cancel or change a booking, what you get back, and how long it takes: flights, hotels and visas.

nodes.html: Here is exactly how cancellations and refunds work for the travel you book with us.
How to cancel or change a booking

Message your advisor, email invite@tripagent.vip or call +91 84518 71851 with your booking reference. We confirm the exact charges before we cancel or change anything, and we act only on your go-ahead.
Flights

items: Cancellations and date or name changes follow the airline's fare rules for your ticket, which we show before you pay. Some fares are non-refundable; others refund part of the fare after the airline's cancellation fee.
What you get back is the amount the airline refunds, less the airline's cancellation or change fee. Taxes the airline refunds are passed back to you in full.
A no-show (not cancelling before departure) usually forfeits the fare; only refundable taxes are recoverable.
If the airline cancels or reschedules the flight, you can choose a free change where the airline offers one, or a full refund of what the airline returns.

nodes.html: Hotels

items: Each room rate has its own cancellation policy, shown before you pay: free cancellation up to a stated date, partially refundable, or non-refundable.
Cancel within the free-cancellation window and the room price is refunded in full. After it, or for a non-refundable rate, the hotel's cancellation charge applies, up to the full price.
Early check-out or a no-show is charged as the hotel's policy states.

nodes.html: Visas
Government and embassy fees are not refundable once an application has been submitted, whatever the outcome. Our handling fee is refunded in full if you cancel before we submit.
Our service fee

items: TripAgent's service fee and the GST on it are refunded in full if a booking cannot be confirmed, or if the airline or hotel cancels it.
Once a booking has been issued, the service fee is not refundable when you cancel or change it yourself.

nodes.html: Failed or duplicate payments
If money left your account but the booking was not confirmed, or you were charged twice, the full amount is refunded automatically, with nothing deducted.
How long refunds take

items: We start the refund within 2 working days of the airline or hotel confirming the amount, or of the cancellation where we hold the money.
Refunds go back to the original payment method and usually reach you within 5–7 working days after that; some banks take up to 10.
We email you when the refund is initiated, with the amount and a reference you can quote to your bank.

nodes.html: Membership
Membership is by invitation and carries a complimentary period with no membership fee, so there is nothing to refund. Leave at any time.
